ordered_diagnoses: Cholangiocarcinoma of the extrahepatic bile duct

s1.syndrome_frame: Right upper abdominal pain with mass and abnormal liver function
salient_findings: Heterogeneous echoic mass near the gallbladder fossa
key_facts: 2-month history of right upper abdominal pain
No nausea, vomiting, chills, or fever
Right upper abdominal tenderness without rebound or palpable masses
Negative Murphy’s sign and shifting dullness
Ultrasonography showed heterogeneous echoic mass near the gallbladder fossa
Contrast-enhanced CT showed lesion in the right hepatic lobe and multiple enlarged hepatic hilar lymph nodes

raw.syndrome_frame: Right upper abdominal pain with mass and abnormal liver function

differentials: Cholangiocarcinoma of the extrahepatic bile duct
Cholangiocarcinoma of the extrahepatic bile duct

shortlist: Cholangiocarcinoma of the extrahepatic bile duct

shortlist.label: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated CA19-9 and imaging findings of a heterogeneous echoic mass near the gallbladder fossa

shortlist.label: Gallbladder cancer
shortlist.why_kept: Gallbladder wall thickening and calcifications in the right liver, along with elevated CEA

shortlist.label: Hepatocellular carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated AFP and a lesion in the right hepatic lobe on contrast-enhanced CT

shortlist.label: Cholangiocarcinoma of the extrahepatic bile duct
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated CA19-9 and multiple enlarged hepatic hilar lymph nodes on CT

shortlist.label: Hepatic metastasis
shortlist.why_kept: Multiple liver lesions and elevated tumor markers (CEA, CA-125, CA19-9)

shortlist.label: Primary sclerosing cholangitis
shortlist.why_kept: Intrahepatic bile duct dilatation on MRI and elevated liver enzymes

shortlist.label: Klatskin tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Lesion in the right hepatic lobe adjacent to the gallbladder fossa and elevated CA19-9

shortlist.label: Bile duct cystadenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Heterogeneous echoic mass near the gallbladder fossa and elevated CA19-9

raw.rationale: Elevated CA19-9 level, presence of a heterogeneous echoic mass near the gallbladder fossa, and mild intrahepatic bile duct dilatation support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Gallbladder cancer
rejected.why: No palpable masses and negative Murphy’s sign make this less likely

rejected.label: Hepatocellular carcinoma
rejected.why: Normal AFP level does not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Cholangiocarcinoma of the extrahepatic bile duct
rejected.why: No extrahepatic primary tumor was identified

rejected.label: Hepatic metastasis
rejected.why: No primary tumor was identified outside the liver

rejected.label: Primary sclerosing cholangitis
rejected.why: No history of inflammatory bowel disease or other risk factors

rejected.label: Klatskin tumor
rejected.why: Tumor location is not at the bifurcation of the hepatic ducts

rejected.label: Bile duct cystadenocarcinoma
rejected.why: No cystic lesions were identified in the bile ducts
